page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute-heavy parallel workloads. It features 54 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, ensuring no resource sharing at the CPU thread level. The system is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.89 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance includes eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined 128 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory. This hardware configuration is paired with 3779 GB of local SSD storage, offering high-speed local data access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers between nodes.

The combination of dedicated x86_64 CPU cores, multiple NVIDIA P100 GPUs, and local SSD storage makes this instance suitable for deep learning training, high-performance computing, scientific simulations, and large-scale parallel processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on the x86_64 architecture, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 54 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, eliminating hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 480.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.89 GB of memory per core. For parallel processing workloads, it bundles eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a total of 128 GB of VRAM. Storage is provided by 3779 GB of local SSD, and the instance supports a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. This hardware profile is optimized for workloads requiring massive GPU concurrency, such as deep learning, molecular modeling, and seismic analysis, where dedicated CPU execution and high-speed local storage are critical.
